title: The 3 Best Electric Skillets Under $70
metaDescription: Our 3 picks for electric skillets under $70, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at electric skillets under $70 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Cuisinart CSK-150 Oval Electric Skillet
products.blurb: Key specs: Oval nonstick cooking surface, 1,500W element, Warm to 450°F range.
strengths: 450°F top temperature is the widest range of any pick on this list, enabling a real sear
1,500W element recovers heat quickly between batches
Stainless steel housing feels and looks more premium than painted metal
Dishwasher-safe pan body once the probe is removed
limitations: Oval shape holds less food than a larger rectangular or round pan
Stainless exterior shows fingerprints and needs regular wiping

products.name: Oster Titanium Infused DuraCeramic 12x16 Electric Skillet
products.blurb: Key specs: 12x16-inch ceramic nonstick surface, Hinged lift-and-serve lid, 1,500W element.
strengths: Titanium-infused ceramic coating resists scratching from metal utensils better than standard nonstick
12x16 surface offers more total cooking area than the Cuisinart's oval pan
Hinged lid stays attached for easier serving straight from counter to table
Ceramic coating releases food with less added oil, a nice bonus for lighter cooking
limitations: Hinged lid cannot be fully removed, limiting deep-cleaning access
Fewer total reviews than more established brands in this category
Bulkier to store than the Cuisinart's oval shape

products.name: Presto 16-Inch Ceramic Electric Skillet with Glass Cover
strengths: Large 16-inch cooking surface for family meals
Fully immersible for cleaning with the heat control removed
limitations: Ceramic coatings lose slickness with high heat
Edges can run cooler than the center

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
